about: WP68: a stray shape grown into a page-sized picture (holdout-3 triage, mechanism A). build_figure grew a picture over images with no budget, so a drawn logo touching a full-page background took every line on the page (h3_15), a thumb tab at the paper's edge took each page of a report (h3_28) and a cover band's stripe stood 372pt tall in the flow (h3_22). Four readings, standard profile only, a switch each in infer.WP68_RULES: image_budget (an image grows a picture under the line budget, refused only where that places it out of the flow, _image_leaves; y06's cover art keeps its reading), margin_strip (a text-free full-height strip standing half in a side margin is furniture), box_bar (a tall narrow bar inside a built box that would take no text is the box's decoration), image_shadow (a one-colour raster under a photograph it holds is the photograph's drop shadow). Nothing is floated. Rule 5 (beside-labels) dropped by the coordinator; h3_13 left. The Google Docs profile is byte-identical.
